summaryLines: cd $R/studio-runner && rm -rf dist && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/write-runtime-versions.mjs; echo DIST_EXIT=$?
cd $R/backend && caffeinate -i ./gradlew clean check --continue --console=plain > $SP/s4c-gradle.log 2>&1; echo GRADLE_CHECK_EXIT=$?
caffeinate -i node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.fixtures.config.ts > $SP/s4c-runner-fixtures.log 2>&1; echo RUNNER_FIXTURES_EXIT=$?
caffeinate -i node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.deployment.config.ts > $SP/s4c-runner-deployment.log 2>&1; echo RUNNER_DEPLOYMENT_EXIT=$?
